criteria.name: Instruction Following
criteria.description: Whether the response follows explicit task instructions and constraints.

scoring_anchors.1: Major failure to follow the requested task.
scoring_anchors.2: Several important instructions or constraints are violated.
scoring_anchors.3: Core task is addressed, but meaningful instructions or constraints are missed.
scoring_anchors.4: Nearly all relevant instructions are followed with only minor deviations.
scoring_anchors.5: All relevant explicit instructions and constraints are followed correctly.

criteria.name: Factual Accuracy
criteria.description: Correctness of externally verifiable claims relative to available evidence or reference material.

scoring_anchors.3: Mostly correct but contains a meaningful error or imprecision.
scoring_anchors.4: Correct overall with at most minor factual imprecision.
scoring_anchors.5: No factual error is detected using the available evidence.

criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.description: Whether content directly contributes to answering the prompt.

scoring_anchors.3: Mostly relevant but includes meaningful digression.
scoring_anchors.4: Highly relevant with minor unnecessary content.
scoring_anchors.5: All material is directly relevant to the task.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Whether all important parts of the request are adequately addressed.

scoring_anchors.3: Core request is answered but meaningful omissions remain.
scoring_anchors.4: Nearly complete with only minor omissions.
scoring_anchors.5: All necessary aspects are adequately addressed.

scoring_anchors.3: Understandable but has noticeable clarity or organization weaknesses.
scoring_anchors.5: Exceptionally clear, precise, coherent, and well organized.
